items.title: Document Parallel Dispatch operator contract and memory boundary
items.context: Update the Lattice Parallel Wave decision doc so dispatch/status/merge/report are explicit non-authoritative operator surfaces, and state that project dev-memory is the existing public experience library, not new gate evidence.
items.userSees: `rg -n "parallel_dispatch|public experience library|cannot satisfy" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md` prints lines naming the four operator commands and the sentence "Dev-memory remains non-authoritative context".

happy.desc: Docs list parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report as read-only operator surfaces and state their user-facing purpose.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly say the project public experience library is the existing dev-memory project/global JSONL storage and no duplicate story/history memory store is introduced.

adversarial.desc: Docs explicitly say dispatch/status/merge/report and dev-memory refs cannot satisfy REVIEW, TEST, DONE, delivery, receipt, or production authority gates and do not auto-spawn agents.

verificationEvidence.note: Docs list all four read-only operator commands and describe their user-facing purpose.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "public experience library|dev-memory project|global|No Duplicate Memory Store" docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs identify existing dev-memory project/global JSONL as the public experience library and explicitly reject a duplicate memory store.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "cannot satisfy REVIEW|do not auto-spawn|production authority|receiptRefs" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs state dispatch/report/status/merge and dev-memory refs cannot satisfy lifecycle, receipt, or production authority gates and do not auto-spawn agents.

items.title: Add core dispatch, status, merge queue, and report projections
items.context: Extend the existing Parallel Wave model with schemas for dispatch manifests, wave status aggregation, serial merge queue guidance, and evidence/report summaries while preserving productionDone=false and receiptRefs=[].
items.userSees: `koala parallel_dispatch --format=json` prints `schemaVersion:"koala.parallel_dispatch.v1"`, story entries with `dispatchable`, and `authority.productionDone:false`; `koala parallel_status --format=json` prints candidate/blocked counts.

happy.desc: Core builders produce schemaVersion values for parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report from an existing wave without mutating the wave.

edge.desc: Blocked dependency stories, plan-only hotspot stories, and parallel-dev candidates remain distinguishable in dispatch/status/merge/report projections.

adversarial.desc: Every new projection preserves authority.productionDone=false, authority.authorityChanged=false, and top-level authority.receiptRefs=[] even when story evidence refs exist.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke asserts core builders produce koala.parallel_dispatch/status/merge_queue/report.v1 projections from an existing wave.
Smoke asserts parallel-dev candidates, plan-only hotspot stories, and dependency-blocked stories remain distinguishable in dispatch/status/merge/report outputs.
Smoke asserts every new projection preserves productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, and receiptRefs=[] even while evidence refs exist.

items.title: Expose CLI commands and policy/fact registrations
items.context: Add read-only CLI surfaces for parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report; register command policy, runtime/process fact level, and default phase availability without adding lifecycle mutations.
items.userSees: `koala help | rg "parallel_dispatch|parallel_status|parallel_merge_queue|parallel_report"` prints all four command names, and each command accepts `--format=json` without changing story state.

happy.desc: MAIN_TOOLS and registry expose parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report with JSON/text output schemas.

edge.desc: All four commands are allowed in default phase tools and registered as supported readOnly commands with destructiveRisk none.

adversarial.desc: All four commands are process fact L0 with no gateConsumer and cannot be marked gateEvidence through policy drift.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts MAIN_TOOLS and createMainRegistry expose all four commands and invokes each through the built CLI with --format=json.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-registry-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Lifecycle and ownership contracts assert all four commands are supported readOnly/all-phase/none-risk commands.
Smoke asserts all four new commands have L0 process fact entries, no gateConsumer, and are not gateEvidence.

items.title: Integrate project public experience library as bounded context
items.context: Reuse existing dev-memory storage by letting dispatch/report include limited non-authoritative experience references when requested; never let those refs satisfy checklist, review, TEST, DONE, or receipt gates.
items.userSees: `koala parallel_dispatch --includeExperience --format=json` prints `experienceRefs` entries with `gateEvidence:false` and `authority:"non_authoritative"`; an empty memory file prints `experienceRefs:[]`.

happy.desc: parallel_dispatch/report can include bounded experienceRefs from seeded project dev-memory entries when includeExperience is requested.

edge.desc: When project/global dev-memory has no matching entries, dispatch/report still succeeds with experienceRefs=[] and visible non-authoritative notes.

adversarial.desc: Experience refs retain gateEvidence=false and authority=non_authoritative, and adding them never changes productionDone, authorityChanged, or receiptRefs.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke seeds project/global dev-memory and asserts parallel_dispatch/report include bounded experienceRefs when includeExperience is requested.
Smoke asserts missing or empty dev-memory succeeds with experienceRefs=[] before seeded memory exists.
Smoke asserts experience refs retain gateEvidence=false and authority=non_authoritative and do not alter authority or receipt refs.

items.title: Verify with focused smoke, build, policy checks, and Koala validation
items.context: Add a smoke test that proves dispatch/status/merge/report JSON shape, no-overwrite behavior, authority boundary, dev-memory boundary, command registration, policy registration, and fact-level registration. Run build and Koala validation before DONE.
items.userSees: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-parallel-wave-smoke` ends with `✓ lattice parallel wave smoke passed`, and `koala validate --story=B-e70f` reports `allPass:true` with required intents covered.

happy.desc: Focused smoke passes and asserts JSON shape, no-overwrite behavior, command registration, policy registration, default phase tools, and process fact levels for all new commands.

edge.desc: npm build passes after adding the projections and CLI schemas, proving TypeScript exports and handler signatures are coherent.

adversarial.desc: koala validate for B-e70f passes with verification coverage for every required intent and does not treat dev-memory or dispatch artifacts as gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke passes and covers JSON shape, no-overwrite behavior, command registration, policy registration, default phase tools, and process fact levels.
TypeScript build passes after adding projections, handlers, CLI schemas, and smoke tests.
Whitespace and enforce scope gates pass; validation coverage is prepared for koala validate and dev-memory/dispatch artifacts remain non-authoritative.
